## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, `mypy` and `pytest` pass locally
- [ ] Model change? An Alembic migration is included (the drift test fails otherwise)
- [ ] New endpoint? It requires login unless it is deliberately public
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes
